syllabus.details: The indicative syllabus for the written examination covers the following topics: | General Knowledge (60 Marks): Current affairs related to national and international issues; Awareness of the events and developments in society; India - History, Freedom Movement, Art & Culture, Geography, Economics, General Polity and Constitution; Awards and Honours (General awareness and current affairs); Sports (General awareness and current affairs); Gender and Weaker Sections (Sensitivity and general awareness); Environmental issues concerning India and World at large; Common Abbreviations; Current Technological Developments in India; Ladakh (History, Art, Culture, Geography and Current Affairs). how_to_apply: Visit the official website of Ladakh Police at police.ladakh.gov.in and click on the designated recruitment link.
Register on the Recruitment Application Software (RAS) using an active mobile number and email address.
Enter personal details, educational qualifications, post preference, category, and domicile information.

Upload a scanned colour passport-size photograph in JPG format (up to 500 KB, dimensions approximately 3.5 cm width × 4.5 cm height, in white background and not older than three months from the date of publication of the notice, 60–70% of the area occupied by full-face view, without cap and spectacles).
Pay the prescribed application fee online via Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards, or UPI.
Submit the completed online application form before 08-11-2026.
Retain a printout/PDF copy of the application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Official contact email for the recruitment board is [email protected]. A candidate applying for the advertised posts must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the Union Territory of Ladakh. A person appointed to the service shall be liable to serve anywhere in the Union Territory of Ladakh, or at such other place as may be specified by the Administration. Candidates who resign within the prescribed period shall be liable to refund training expenses/pay and allowances as prescribed under the applicable rules/orders. The recruitment process will be conducted at Leh and Kargil examination centres as opted by the candidate. Centre change requests will not be permitted after closure of the application process. Applicants are advised to submit only one application; duplicate applications will be rejected. Admit cards will not be sent by post and must be downloaded from the Ladakh Police official website starting 14.11.2026. In case of a tie in aggregate marks, the older candidate shall be placed higher in merit; if still tied, alphabetical order of names shall be applied.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies have been notified across four distinct posts in the Ladakh Fire and Rescue Service. The post-wise and category-wise distribution of vacancies is given below as per the approved operative roster: Horizontal reservation provides 20% for Ex-Agniveers and 6% for Ex-Servicemen. The provision of 4% horizontal reservation for Outstanding Sportspersons (OSP) has not been applied due to unavailability of posts.

rows.category: Residents of areas adjoining Actual Line of Control (ALC)

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate applying for any advertised post must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the Union Territory of Ladakh issued by the competent authority. The prescribed educational qualification and driving licence must have been acquired on or before the last date fixed for submission of online application forms. Candidates whose qualifying examination result has been declared on or before the cut-off date and who are declared passed may also be considered, subject to production of documentary evidence. Physical Measurement Test (PMT) standards apply to Fireman, Fireman Driver, and Fireman Ministerial: Male Candidates: Height: 162 cm minimum; Chest: 81 cm unexpanded minimum, 85 cm expanded minimum. Female Candidates: Height: 152 cm minimum. Only candidates qualifying the PMT are permitted to appear in the PET. Events are conducted in the following qualifying order: Event 1 - Long Race: 1600 meters in 7 minutes for males; 1000 meters in 6 minutes 30 seconds for females. Event 2 - Vertical Rope: Climb rope to a minimum height of 4 meters from ground level. Event 3 - Load Carrying Test: Carry a weight of 63.5 kg (males) / 50 kg (females) and run a distance of 91.44 meters in 1 minute. Event 4 - Bent Knee Sit-Ups: 25 sets in 90 seconds (males); 20 sets in 90 seconds (females). Candidates shall lie face-up on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, stacking their forearms in front of the chest and raise torso back to the starting position. Event 5 - Walk on Beam: Walk across a beam secured to the level floor (7 meters long and 8 cm wide) carrying a load of 17 kg (males) / 13 kg (females) in three attempts without falling off or stepping off the beam. Male Candidates: Long Race of 1600 meters in 7 minutes and 30 seconds. Female Candidates: Long Race of 1000 meters in 7 minutes and 30 seconds.

rows.qualification_required: Must have passed 10+2 from a recognised Board of School Education with Physics and Chemistry.
Must have passed 10th from a recognised Board of School Education and must possess driving license Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) with (TRANS).
Must have passed 12th from a recognised Board of School Education, along with a minimum speed of 35 words per minute in typewriting on computer keyboard, with 90% accuracy.
Must have passed 10th from a recognised Board of School Education.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online via Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards, or UPI on the Recruitment Application Software (RAS) when submitting the online application form. Applications received without the prescribed fee shall not be considered valid and will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances, nor shall it be adjusted against any other examination or selection. Candidates who made excess payment are advised to apply to the Board with documentary evidence for a refund.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following sequential stages: Physical Standard Test (PST): Qualifying in nature. Physical Endurance Test (PET): Qualifying in nature. Scrutiny of original documents/testimonials: Qualifying in nature. Computer Test / Driving Test / Trade Test: 50 marks for Fireman Ministerial (Computer Test, 35 wpm typing speed with 90% accuracy; failing disqualifies from further process); 50 marks for Fireman Driver (Driving Test); maximum of 100 marks for Sweeper/Safaiwala (Trade Test, no written exam will be conducted). Written Examination: 100 marks for Fireman and Fireman Driver. For Fireman, the general select list is prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the Written Examination. For Fireman Driver, marks obtained in the driving test (50 marks) are added to the marks obtained in the written examination.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination for Fireman and Fireman Driver will be conducted either as an OMR Based Test or Computer Based Test or Tablet Based Test. The question standard is approximately Matriculation level. The paper comprises objective/MCQ type questions, carrying 1 mark each. The question paper will be in English only. There is no negative marking.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The indicative syllabus for the written examination covers the following topics: General Knowledge (60 Marks): Current affairs related to national and international issues; Awareness of the events and developments in society; India - History, Freedom Movement, Art & Culture, Geography, Economics, General Polity and Constitution; Awards and Honours (General awareness and current affairs); Sports (General awareness and current affairs); Gender and Weaker Sections (Sensitivity and general awareness); Environmental issues concerning India and World at large; Common Abbreviations; Current Technological Developments in India; Ladakh (History, Art, Culture, Geography and Current Affairs). Reasoning (15 Marks): Analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualisation, spatial orientation, problem solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, coding-decoding, non-verbal series, number series, alphabet series and number ranking. General Science (10 Marks): Basic principles of General Science and Life Science up to 10th Class level. Arithmetic Abilities (15 Marks): Number System, Simple Interest, Average, Ratio and Proportion, Percentage, Profit and Loss, Time and Work, Work and Wages, Time and Distance, Clocks and Calendars, Mensuration, LCM/HCF, Simple Equations, Square Roots, Bar/Graphs and Data Interpretation.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates may edit their particulars in the online application form after initial submission until the last date for submission (08-11-2026) by logging in with their registered mobile number. However, the Date of Birth and Category fields cannot be edited after submission. Some other fields may also not be editable once submitted.

content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying the PET must produce the following original documents along with self-attested copies during document scrutiny: Matriculation/10th certificate Domicile Certificate of UT of Ladakh Category Certificate (SC, ST, ALC, EWS) Educational qualification certificate (10th/12th/10+2 marksheet) Ex-Agniveer certificate/documents, if applicable Driving Licence (LMV with TRANS), if applicable for Fireman Driver Discharge certificate in case of Ex-Servicemen No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned Head of Department for in-service government candidates Any other document required under the applicable rules/orders Valid Photo-ID proof containing full date of birth (Aadhaar card/printout of e-Aadhaar, Voter ID card, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, College/University ID Card, or Employer's ID Card Govt./PSU/Private) Two recent passport-size colour photographs (the same as uploaded during submission of the online application form) for appearing in PST

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under LPSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies have been announced across Fireman (11), Fireman Driver (04), Fireman Ministerial (01), and Sweeper/Safaiwala (01) posts.

faq.question: Q2. When will the online application start and what is the last date?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 22 October 2026 and the last date for submission is 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for LPSSRB Fireman posts?
faq.answer: The application fee for Fireman, Driver, and Ministerial posts is Rs 600/- for UR/EWS candidates and Rs 500/- for SC, ST, and ALC candidates. For Sweeper/Safaiwala, it is Rs 450/- for UR/EWS and Rs 400/- for SC/ST/ALC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as on 01.01.2026 for Fireman, Fireman Driver, and Fireman Ministerial posts, and 18 to 40 years for Sweeper/Safaiwala.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation under this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and ALC categories receive 5 years of age relaxation, while Ex-Servicemen receive deduction of actual military service from their age as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Fireman requires 10+2 with Physics and Chemistry; Fireman Driver requires 10th pass and an LMV (TRANS) licence; Fireman Ministerial requires 12th pass and 35 wpm typing speed; and Sweeper/Safaiwala requires a 10th pass.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Fireman Driver?
faq.answer: The selection process for Fireman Driver comprises PST, PET, document scrutiny, a 50-mark driving test, and a 100-mark written examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking in the 100-mark written examination.

faq.question: Q9. When will the PST and PET commence?
faq.answer: The PST and PET process will commence from 20 November 2026 onwards, with admit cards available for download starting 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Ladakh apply for these posts?
faq.answer: No, only candidates who possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the Union Territory of Ladakh are eligible to apply.
